user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server URL and API key (read access to people, assets and faces). Then add your rooms with "Add room".

abort.already_configured: This Immich server is already configured

data_description.calendar: Stays (one event per stay or per guest): photos start at arrival hour and end the day after the last day at 00:01. Without a calendar, the guest is shown as soon as entered.
data_description.helpers: Order matters: frame 1 shows the guest of the 1st helper, frame 2 the 2nd.
data_description.door_frame: Outside a stay: logo and room name. During a stay: guests' faces, welcome line and dates.
data_description.room_frames: 0, 1 or 2. During a stay: one frame per guest; a single guest: their photos on both frames, no duplicates.

reconfigure.title: Room settings
reconfigure.description: The room id does not change: entities and frame URLs are kept.

data_description.calendar: Stays (one event per stay or per guest): photos start at arrival hour and end the day after the last day at 00:01. Without a calendar, the guest is shown as soon as entered.
data_description.helpers: Order matters: frame 1 shows the guest of the 1st helper, frame 2 the 2nd.
data_description.door_frame: Outside a stay: logo and room name. During a stay: guests' faces, welcome line and dates.
data_description.room_frames: 0, 1 or 2. During a stay: one frame per guest; a single guest: their photos on both frames, no duplicates.

error.room_exists: A room with this name already exists
error.no_helpers: Select at least one input_text helper
error.too_many_helpers: Two guests at most per room

general.title: General settings
general.description: Each room is set on its own row (Reconfigure).

data.permanent_persons: Owners (exact names or Immich IDs, comma separated)
data.arrival_hour: Stay start hour on arrival day
data.min_photos: Minimum photos per guest (below, a repair is raised)

picpak.title: PicPak e-ink frames
picpak.description: The number of frames and the door frame are set per room. During a stay, a frame gets one photo per interval, as many as the stay's hours (quiet hours excluded). Frame URLs come from the "PicPak: frame URLs" action.

data.picpak_photos: Photos per frame for a room without calendar
data.picpak_logo_2: Logo of frame 2 (optional; empty = same logo)
data.picpak_title: Text logo title, if the logo file is missing
data.picpak_base_url: Local Home Assistant URL as seen by frames (empty = automatic)

error.invalid_base_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://
error.base_url_too_long: The full frame URL would exceed 128 characters (frame limit): shorten the address

confirm.title: Link {name} to an Immich person
confirm.description: "{name}" (room: {rooms}) matches nobody in Immich (or several people share this exact name). In Immich, open the person's page and copy its URL (http://…/people/…) or just the ID, then paste it here. The link is remembered.

error.invalid_person_id: No valid ID found in this value
error.person_not_found: This ID does not exist in Immich

confirm.title: Link {name} to the right Immich person
confirm.description: "{name}" (room: {rooms}) has only {found} photo(s) in Immich (minimum: {minimum}). All available photos are shown. If this is the wrong person, paste the ID or page URL of the right one; the link is remembered.

error.invalid_person_id: No valid ID found in this value
error.person_not_found: This ID does not exist in Immich

helper_missing.title: Helper not found: {name}
helper_missing.description: The helper "{name}" configured for room {rooms} does not exist: this room sees no guest. Create it, or fix the room: Settings → Devices & services → Immich Guest Slideshow → the room's row → Reconfigure.
